text: You would think with no onsite dining that they could get can order of three burritos right. But you would be wrong. They managed to to get two out of three wrong and then when you try to call them they dont answer the phone. I would HIGHLY recommend checking your order before you leave. Dont assume they can get anything right.

Worst experience of my life , and the worst waitress I've had at any restaurant I've ever been at . Couldn't get a refill to save my life i had one small water my entire 1 hr of being there , the lady didn't even greet us or really say anything to us to make sure we were good . I felt like i was just attempting to eat at McDonald's dine in area. I  wish i could 0 stars . After waiting an hour (there wasn't many people at the restaurant ) for my food they brought me out this hilariously soggy chicken cheesesteak. I had one bite and asked for my check . This place STINKS. I  will never be back , idc if they were giving free meals and paying for my attendance
Service was great the food a little dey for my personal taste but the drinks were amazing and the place was nice and BREEZY haha
I've been a few times here I had a tenderloin was perfect and I came in for breakfast best Biscuits and gravy ever pretty big menu you should check it out

I am not a big fan of buffet, but I have to say, this one knocked it out of the park......Due to current virus scare, you no longer serve yourself, the chef does, so no grimy hands on utensils..... My drink never went empty, the food was fresh and flavorful....  Your options were great, and they can accommodate large parties...

I'm not sure what's happening with this location, but it's becoming more frequent that you have to wait and wait for your food. My husband has been inside for 20 minutes and still has not come out. Entrées also or not being refilled in a timely manner. We love our Panda Express, but we want to see improvement in the service at this location. Thanks!
Realllllly good sushi, tasted very fresh, generous portions. Fast service despite the dining room being full. Absolutely will go again.
Had dinner here on a Saturday night.  No wait to sit.  Got a great view of the live music and the food was so good!  Our server Grayson was very friendly and on top of anything we needed.
I love this place. Generous portions and delicious food. Don't miss the pork belly with brown sauce!
Great addition to the area. I had the pastrami and eggs with Swiss on rye bread. Awesome!

I was surprised I had not already left a review for Bridge! It was the last place we dined out before covid and one of our first stops once it reopened. I simply love the atmosphere here! I've stopped in for a quick drink, date nights, even groups, and not been disappointed. The wine and beer list is huge and always updating. The food is carefully curated and also regularly refreshed with new options. My favorite is just to drop in, get a pint and a few items from the charcuterie board. The staff is always professional and attentive. Go to Bridge if you are downtown!

Low-key Mexican restaurant with sidewalk seating overlooking Lafayette Square. The outdoor tables and chairs are basic metallic ones.

Solid complimentary chips and salsa, but be careful because the salsa is very spicy. I ordered the Espinacas salad with shrimp and it was very basic, but tasty. The shrimp was spicy but delicious as well. 

Our waiter was very attentive even though we were sitting outside.

I came in early in the morning and got my order taken (it was to go) and waited 40 mins to get my food yes 40 mins !! All the people that came in after me got their food, I would understand if the restaurant was full but it was half full !! Don't recommend

One of my favorites on our side of town. I absolutely love their salsa! Definitely a fresh vibe for cantina style Mexican in the Donelson/Hermitage area. Nothing like it! Love that they also have coffee and juice items so when Caliber coffee is closed I can still get my fix. In my particular experience lately, my Barista was fabulous in her recommendations and helping me pick something out of my norm. I go there about once a month or every other and have always had great food. Also love that they have bowl options. I do agree lately the tacos are lacking but there is a lot of competition for them in Nashville. Being back the beet root taco!!
Excellent risotto!!!! I ordered the lobster risotto special, and it was incredible. The panna cotta was delicious as well! Great service, setting, and menu. Will definitely be back!

Had the best brunch here! We sat at the bar and Madison was our bartender. She was awesome, attentive, and super friendly. The food was amazing and Madison gave us great suggestions when we had questions. Would definitely recommend!!
Listen! Soooo good! Ordered the crawfish pie's ($1.99 each!) and they were DELICIOUS! Just a kick of spice  little hidden gem...walk in and head to the back for your order :)

My husband and I stayed here last year and really enjoyed our stay.  The service was excellent and we enjoyed our dinner at the restaurant.  We had a corner room with a great bath tub.  I'm a picky sleeper but found the bed to be comfortable enough for me.  We spent an extra $1000 to stay at another hotel down the road this year but were surprised to discover that Zamora was actually more comfortable in comparison.  Zamora definitely has more value for the money.  Overall, I would consider staying there again.

We have just returned to New Hope after being away for two and a half years and and as it was before we left, Tastebuds continues to be our favorite restaurant in town. John, the owner is charming and welcoming, and the food is just terrific! And one of the best parts for a New Hope resident is that there is PARKING! Great restaurant all around.
Great place to stop in for a brew or bite to eat! The staff is very friendly and the bartenders in the tap room are very knowledgeable! Will be back again!

Stopped in for a nice dinner and we enjoyed it. The interior is spacious and set up nicely and there were plenty of people working there so the service was good.
They have a nice bar and the specialty cocktails we ordered didn't disappoint. For dinner we ordered the strip steak and the trout along with a side of Brussel sprouts and corn bread and they were all very good. The steak wasn't seasoned enough to my liking and it was at that time I noticed there wasn't any S&P on ANY of the tables so I had to wait a couple minutes for our waitress to finish tending to another table. Not a big deal but they should have been on that.
The corn bread is very good but it takes 20 minutes to prepare as stated on the menu and we had it with our mains. We noticed a couple come in well after us and sit down and their corn bread was immediately brought to them and they ate it as an app. They must have called prior to getting there and had them put it on for them which I thought was pretty cool.
The desserts looked great but we didn't have time but next time we definitely will.

We stopped at Addie's for breakfast in Easter Sunday. It was about half-full of people.  I saw reviews from other yelpers and decided to take a chance.  It has a good ol' diner feel to it.  I was impressed when my son spilled milk everywhere and they cleaned it up quick without complaining. Service was great. The food was good. I would go back. Nice classic diner fare, no fuss, no muss.
Slowest one in St. Louis and you're lucky if they get the meal right.. always a bad time

Unfortunately, my husband and I have been wanting to try this place for a while, and when we finally did, we weren't impressed.  The potatoes and fresh orange juice was our favorite.  If you want variety, this is not your place.  They really only have biscuits and gravy, no other breakfast food, so you'd think thwir gravy is amazing....but no.  The gravy is so thick it reminded me of paper mache from art class as a kid =/.  And I love biscuits and gravy.  Maybe we caught them on an off day, but we won't be going back, especially with their short hours and being closed on Sundays.

"THE" place to go for a great meal in Palm Harbor.  Food was fantastic.  Asked Savannah our waitress for a recommendation and I got the lobster grilled cheese.  FANTASTIC!...(wait I said that already).  The lobster roll was also great.  My grandsons age 2 and 5 just ate up their grilled shrimp and fries and Mahi sandwich.  Asked specifically for the grilled shrimp as opposed to fried and Savannah said no problem.
Bottom line...Great food...Great atmosphere (mostly outdoor dining)...great value...great service, (thanks Savannah)...great time.  Do not  pass this place up

We tried New Delhi for the first time today and it was DELICIOUS. We had the veggie samosas, garlic naan, and aloo gobi matar. Everything was super tasty! The service was excellent and all staff were wearing gloves and masks and very friendly and attentive. Will def return

The service here today was absolutely amazing. The woman that helped me with my Baker's Dozen was very polite, professional, and helpful. The cashier was also very friendly and efficient. So, great experience overall in the store. 

The bagels were absolutely delicious on top of it all. Thanks guys!!!

Funny story, I called in to order some appetizers and ordered.. chicken teriyaki sticks, fried won tons and 3 won tons soups. No I am think individual sizes soup.. but nope I got 3 Large soups.. see picture. Well good thing the soup was delicious because we are going to be eating it for days.  chicken sticks are extremely good and fried wontons quite tasty too.
We haven't been here in a while as there are two Chinese places closer but really enjoyed the food abs my husband is already planning a return next week.

The perfect Hookah bar. I'm not sure what they do differently but their hookah never gets harsh. We had ours for almost 4 hours and it didn't get harsh at all. The environment is good, our server Ally was very attentive and friendly. Don't let their plastic cups fool you the drinks are great. Only issue is they have gratuity included and it's at managers discretion right on the menu: Theoretically they could charge you a 100% tip, (ours was only 10).


Ps our hookah never ran out, at other bars it only last about 2 hours so they really fill it up. I will surely return .

We started coming here with our realtor/friend last year in April.  We were sold on day 1.  We've been back several times.  We come to see Jericho turnpike band. We come as a couple. We come in large groups.  We come here for the brunch on Sundays. We have never had bad food or service.  I can't believe I haven't written a review.  They always have different specials going on on different nights. They are always coming up with new drink ideas. We have had the beef on wheck, pizzas, and almost all brunch items. Yesterday we got to go food for a small gathering amid corona virus.  We got meatloaf sliders, meatball sliders, fried pickles and Mac and cheese bites.  It was all very good.  We ordered 2 drinks while we waited for our food. It was a very healthy pour :) 

I have more pictures that I want to add to this review!
The food was soooooo good, the drinks were on point and the service was amazing! Definitely recommend, especially for dog owners.

Such a pleasant surprise that we stumbled upon this gem. The food was AMAZING. My boyfriend and I could not stop talking about how perfect everything tasted. I got the avocado tacos which were perfectly crispy and full of flavor. He got the steak/shrimp burrito that had fries inside! The flavors were so on point. 

I had probably the best mojito I've ever tried. It was so minty and coco nutty. The atmosphere is rustic and chic. The bar area looked super cool, we will probably sit there next time we go. 

Overall, I think everything on the menu sounds exciting and I'm eager to try it all lol. Our server was so sweet as well.

5/5!!

We went here for dinner. 

Neapolitan pizza: the pizza was too greasy and sad/anemic-looking. The crust was thin, though, which was good! 

Carozza: 2/5. The cheese was good but the bread was not. Not authentic; it was more like an Italian grilled cheese. 

Greek panini (daily special): panini was okay. There was like 1/4 of a chicken breast on it and a ton of spinach. The ratio didn't really make sense. The bread used for the panini was good. 

Staff is very friendly and they cleared the table regularly which was nice. 

Men's bathroom was atrocious and the urinal was like a pig trough. It felt like I was pissing in medieval France. I ended up pissing in a regular toilet which I noted did not have a toilet seat. It was just a hole.

I came here with a friend to get my sushi fix. We walked in and were immediately seated and didn't have to wait. I ordered the Pokémon Go and the Spicy Hulk without tuna. The Pokémon go was DELICIOUS!!!! I will order this over and over again each time i dine here. I do not like anything spicy so I'm not sure what made me get the Spicy Hulk,  but it definitely lived up to its name. If you love spicy food you won't be disappointed with this one. I made it through with LOTS of water, but it was still very good. Overall I have nothing bad to say about this place and will definitely come back.
Best bagels and lox in the area. Everything else is amazing too. Family friendly place where everyone can find something they like.

Such a great find! Pretty rare place that offers direct trade coffee as a faith-based business that provides an environment of peace with music and a comfortable area to read. And just like they state, it's about community here. Mark was so welcoming and helpful having it be my first time here. The cold brew is phenomenal with actual coffee ice cubes. I will definitely be back! :)
Atmosphere is very nice, sunsets are beautiful from the restaurant and the food is nice. Love the brunch on weekends as well.

Even for Covid style outdoor dining it was pretty terrible. The table and chairs weren't clean that's for sure I watched the girl quickly swipe a rag over the table once and there were still crumbs on each chair. Bad start but wasn't a huge deal. the trainee was honestly better than our regular server (friendlier, more attentive, actually checked on us his name was Tyler he was doing really well!) Followed by cold cheese sauce again not a big deal but we got a small sauce cup and it was a little less than a quarter filled for 4 pretzels. We asked for more which we quickly got but the server (not the trainee) spilled Fresh HOT cheese sauce on my friends foot and burned her. We got a bigger replacement cup of cheese that made it to the table and the rest of the meal was fine. There were not one but 2 hairs in our food and it was overall just kind of a disaster. It was just a bunch of smaller things that equates to an overall strange experience. However, the hostess (I forget her name but she's a little on the shorter side dark hair and has these pretty bright green acrylics on) and the trainee earned that second star in the review. Despite all the little mishaps the hostess just had such a good energy and was so friendly that it just made the atmosphere so much better. She remember everybody's names said hello and goodbye to absolutely every single person she just put that extra effort in that you normally don't see. Tyler the trainee  was very friendly as well, came out to upd

Simply the BEST Sushi restaurant I've ever eaten at!! Amazing!! A friend from Tokyo brought us here and we have been going here ever since!!! Fried eggplant and teriyaki beef scallion is to die for!!!! Fish is always so fresh!! Nothing compares!!!

The produce and baked goods at this store is often old and rotting. Check the expiration dates! Stick with packaged staples and frozen food. What bothers me the most, however, is how surly the customer service/cashiers are. The older woman is notoriously snotty - i try to be nice to her but she is snarly and needs some training on how to be pleasant and friendly. The younger staff are nicer. I once had a cashier pocket my change - there was like 43 cents in change and I had to ask for it and she was like "oh, you want it?" As if that was somehow unusual? There is a local Giant Heirloom market a block away - better for fresher produce. Only problem there is that it's all self-check out. However, given how rude the check out is at South square, maybe that's better anyway.

Good morning mom has a stable Indianapolis. I've been here on dates, family gatherings, brunch with friends are looking just to get some good pancakes. If you were looking for some good and basic breakfast food then you are in the right place. This is the place you come where are you know exactly what to expect at least sometimes. I would definitely suggest his spot especially if your breakfast person.
Such good pizza. The garlic butter on the crust got me. They have so much on the menu and they have the best cakes ever. The employees are really cool too.
Came in a while back for breakfast and was not disappointed. The portion size for the price is great as well as the service. Have gone back twice since my first visit!

Checked out this restaurant on Friday evening in South Common. Online reservation was not available. Waiting time for Walk-in was around 30 minutes. 
Finally got a table and we ordered food quickly.


Order:
Baja Fish Tacos: Fish and Valentina's guacamole wrapped in white corn tortilla topped with cheese. Tacos were too salty and i could not enjoy it. I tried fish tacos from Julio's barrio too but they were far better than this.

Hand-pressed Burger: 
Angus beef with mushroom cheddar and cheddar bacon was also a normal burger, i didn't find anything wow in this burger leaving me quite disappointed. 

Rating:
Ambience: 4/5 ( Ambience was cheerful and vibrant)
Service: 4.5/5 (Service was pretty fast)
Taste : 3/5 ( Baja Fish tacos were pathetic)
Presentation: 3/5
Value for money: 3/5 ( I believe, i will think twice before coming here again)

Staying at the Nugget and was looking for some good enchiladas near by.  This place hit a home run.  It is tough for me to find any good enchiladas verde in Fresno.  This place knows how to do it just like Baja but they are in Sparks.  We shared a plate of chicken and a plate of shrimp enchiladas both with green sauce.  Too much food but we did our best.  This will be on our go to restaurant list every time we visit Sparks/Reno.

We love the food at Verde,  but if they don't post prices on the web menu for dinner that's a no-go for us.  This not this is Le Cirque or some high-end place.  It's annoying that I have to call and ask what the prices are for dishes when we do take out.  And, my guess is that they do benefit from take out business.  Put the prices of your dinner dishes online.  Not doing this is costing you customers. We decided not to order tonight because of this mystery. If you are choosing to hide the dinner prices, you are okay with hiding things and that's not good.

We were disappointed and actually really disgusted by the behavior of the staff, including the manager, of what we witnessed towards another family. We watched the entire exchange and the staff was in the wrong and should be, frankly, fired. We observed and heard every word spoken. The family was reprimanded for having too many in their party because 2 of the party of 8 showed up late. We told the server we had no problem of them joining the party of 6. He rudely barked at me and told me no due to the social distancing "laws".  The 2 family members that showed up late said they'd sit at the table behind them. The server walked them to the bar area for a few minutes and then came back and sat them behind the party of 6. All good, right? No. One, that was a scene in of itself. The 2 that sat separately were approached by the server about 5 minutes later and he said to them "sorry guys" in a laughing, smirking tone. The couple replied "are you?". The server abruptly left and another 5 minutes later came back with the manager who kicked them out stating they were not following social distancing rules. THIS IS A COMPLETE RIGHT OUT LIE. We hated witnessing this behavior. We were in shock to what just happened. The rest of the party got up and left. We got up and left and expressed our displeasure and how appalled we were of the sickening display of what just went down.  This was our 2nd time there because they were the only restaurant that had tables available along that restaurant

Went out for a nice date night with my wife to Estia. It had been quite a few years since I visited this establishment.  They had a nice fixed price special for $35 which included an appetizer, entree, and dessert although the choices I picked cost a little extra such as the octopus and lamb chops but it was totally worth it.  The service was up to par and you can't knock anything about the ambiance of the restaurant.  Had a very pleasant night and looking forward to coming back in the future.
Good food and great cocktails, we sat on their porch so essentially we were outside and socially distant from others. Very nice wait staff
Beside being closed down in Sept. 2020 for a heath code violation of cooking food in Ethanol Drums they are a nuisance to the neighborhood with obscenely loud music until all hours of the night.

Service was meh, food was disappointing. $16 linguini with muscles and the muscles weren't even in the shell which is suspicious. The restaurant had 10 open tables but the wait to be seated was still 10 minutes!

Y'all...I'm a chef by trade and love all foods. Wow does this awesome place have service, smiles, amazing food and ambience! Kudos to the entire staff! Thanks for the samples of great bakery items! The Bison burger was amazing down to the pretzel bun! Thanks for a new (fav) adventure! We will be back! #crushingit

I've been here several times now and it is by far my favorite sushi place in Reno!  This visit was during the covid19 quarantine so takeout was the only option. To my surprise everything was just as fresh and delicious. We ordered a spicy tuna, California, Mermaid and Ceviche roll. I highly recommend the Ceviche which has a thin lemon slice topped with red onion and jalapeños!  We also got a tuna poke bowl and everything was super fresh.  I'm going to have a hard time trying any other place.

We were in from out of town - visiting the area and decided upon this restaurant based upon reviews.   One of the reasons I chose this place was the following listed on their web site, "Our team is taking all safety measures to ensure you and your guests are safe while dining here"...we were looking to eat in a safe environment during this pandemic.   The food was very good - and the service, for the most part, was very good.   When I arrived, I asked the host if he had a table that was safely placed away from others - as is encouraged by pandemic protocols.  He said, "well....I don't know how well I can do that, but I will show you the table and you can decide".     Next the waitress came over and while asking for our drink order, she repeatedly slid her mask down off her mouth and nose to her chin.   I had to request she not do this again.   That was the last we had her for service - she turned us over to another waitperson.   Lastly, as the night progressed so did the crowds, and people coming in and milling about without masks.  Most everyone who needed to use the bathrooms were walking from their tables without masks.   It was just a total meltdown of infection control protocols ESPECIALLY when the numbers in Florida are rising as such a high rate.
I would NOT recommend this place at THIS time because they seem unable to police their patrons to follows Covid restrictions.   Again, food was very good, service was good - but, did I feel safe...NO.   We ate fast and got out

Super great band, lovely establishment, but horrible service! The bartenders were extremely rude. My fiancé and I order a bottle of champagne, they were rude while taking our order, rude cashing us out, and took our wine chiller away for another table mid way through the bottle. After we asked for another chiller they refilled our glasses and put our bottle of wine in the ice pit. We've had nothing but great service until coming to this place. Unfortunate.

We had a wonderful experience at the Green Chili.  It was our second visit.  Previously, we did the lunch buffet. This evening we had the Paneer Chili Dry and Chicken Pakora for appetizers.  The Paneer (homemade cheese) dish was surprisingly delicious and many believe the best food of the night.  The flavors were bold but not too spicy.  For dinner we ordered the Tandoori Chicken, Lamb Jal Frezi, Desi Chicken Curry, and the Bread Basket.  The food was awesome and plenty for all to share as well as a healthy leftovers.  I really encourage you to try the Bread Basket that has 4 varieties of Naan.  The restaurant is near the freeway overhead and very unassuming.  Don't let that fool you as this is some of the best Indian food we've had in years and the best in the area.  Enjoy.
#LightTheWorld

Top 5 cheesesteak in Philly!

* Cheesesteak: Cooper Wit - Soft seeded roll; easy to bite through. Steak tasted like it was marinated/seasoned which I prefer. Onions were in between caramelized and raw. I would prefer the onions were more caramelized(leave on grill for a few extra minutes), however that's my personal preference.

* Chicken Cutlet Italiano: Broccoli Rabe, Sharp Provolone & Roasted Hot Peppers - Chicken was cooked/fried to perfection. Crispy outside with crunch, however melt in your mouth inside texture. Soft seeded roll; easy to chew through.

Also, the truffle fries were great, however not reviewing. No offense to the truffle fries.
It's just damned good. The understand food. They really understand red meat. Oh, and beer, booze, beans, and chocolate cake. They really understand those,too

They currently have Axxess deals for lunch and dinner which is definitely amazing. The drinks are delicious and the enchiladas are worth trying! The margaritas towers are great for parties and fiesta time.

So, I ordered a supreme deep dish and went to pick up pizza. It was a thin crust supreme. The waiter offered to have it remade but at that point we were hungry and didn't want to wait. He didn't offer any other way to make it right. Pizza was okay but sparse in toppings for $24.

I came in one day to grab lunch and I was blown away with the portion size and delicious food.  I had the catfish, greens and smashed potatoes.  Also the peach cobbler. All was excellent and cannot wait to come back for breakfast or use them for catering.

I'm sad that I have to write this review. I've given this place 3 tries now. The first experience was decent. Their Crab Rangoon is phenomenal and I love the general tso chicken. The second time I went was awful. We came in, sat down and ordered our appetizer. There were maybe 2 other tables at the time. The owner (I assume) took our appetizer order and brought it out. We then ordered our entree and waited. We waited for 1 hour and 15 minutes. 3 different tables came in, ate and left. We went up and asked if our food would be out soon and she yelled back to "drop more general tso". We said never mind and paid and left. Tonight I decided to try again. The same woman answered the phone and told me to hold on. I waited for 5 minutes and heard her ring 3 different people out. She then picked up the phone and told me to hold on again. 30 seconds later she picked up the phone and said "you have to come in and pay with a card" and then hung up on me. I then called back and told her she hung up on me after holding for 5 minutes. She replies "yeah you have to come in and pay with a card". I explained that I wanted to PLACE and order to come in and pick up. No apology or anything, just "oh ok go ahead and order". Needless to say I went to a place closer and much friendlier. They will not be getting my business again. Extremely rude.
This is by far the best spot for a great Happy Hour.  They offer awesome drink & food specials and the staff is super friendly and knowledgeable.

Belleair Coffee Company was an adorable coffee shop -- modern/remodeled. They have many options including muffins, croissants, quiches, coffee, teas! My only complaint would be that my husband and I got the 2 last breakfast sandwiches at 10AM. The long line behind us was then out of luck at such an early time. Regardless, our experience was very nice.
Great place. Nice seating. Good crowd. Love the staff here. Like their veggie breakfast sandwich. Very nice coffee too.

This joint is always busy, so go early! Not much waiting room either, so be prepared to huddle or wait outside. They do provide coffee while you wait for your table and that's a huge bonus. The food is always good and there is plenty of it! My hubs and I have been a few times now and they are always short staffed, so while they try and hustle, service can be slow.

Nice lunch spot, cheap prices for local workers and fresh made! The pizza is really great after it cools off! It's hot when they **update reply** 2 stars loss because the gyro meat didn't have any taste, can use some seasoning and and I've had the wings before and they can also use a bit more seasoning!

This is one of the worst restaurants. The food is good. The staff is unresponsive. They don't even acknowledge when you are waiting. The manager is just as bad. They treat delivery drivers even worse than their customers. Avoid this location!

This was my first visit. I'd read all the reviews and driven by and seen the small parking lot always full at night. My test dish is pad ke mao (drunken noodles, which Siam Cafe calls spicy noodles). So that's what I had. I ordered it medium hot, and they got the spice level perfect to my taste. But the noodles were too oily, and just didn't measure up to other Thai places such as Thai Phooket and King Market. Also, I ran out of water before it got refilled, and had I used the side dish of chili, I would have been in trouble. It looks like curry is the preferred dish here, so next time I'll try that.

Wow. Edessa is my new favorite Nashville restaurant. Not only is the food authentic, fresh, and delicious, the service is top notch. 
We started with the appetizer platter, filled with wonderful dips. The baba ganoush was our favorite. We also enjoyed a hot appetizer, a flatbread filled with spinach and cheese. This might have been my favorite dish of the night. The chicken kabob dinner was cooked perfectly juicy and tender, served with buttery rice and veggies. We finished the night with walnut and pistachio baklava, both incredible and not too heavy. 

Get to Edessa if you haven't been yet. You won't find better.
very rude brothers. do not support this business they do not deserve it. went in for tamales and they were not willing to sell us any, told us to go to costco instead. very very rude establishment.
Great historic gem. At first I was hesitant about going thru because of the price ( my bride says I am cheap),but after seeing the theater I was amazed. This place is a must see in Nashville.

We went recently when things finally started opening up for indoor dining. As usual, this place was amazing. The staff is sweet, helpful and just take so much pride In delivering customer satisfaction. We had several dishes, including oxtail pho, rice noodles with beef and a chicken dish. All were amazing.  I'd highly recommend eating here and supporting a local hidden gem.

I had heard about T-Swirl Crêpe before and always wanted try one of their crepes because I heard so many good things about it. I decided to check them out with a group of friends who were visiting from out of town because I wanted to see what the hype was about.

First thing I noticed was that they had an extensive menu in which all of the items on the sweet side looked so good. But I decided to get the blueberry cheesecake crepe because I am usually never disappointed with cheesecake flavored deserts. 

One thing thats pretty cool is that you get to see how they are made, I always appreciate that.

I did get to try the bubble tea from my friends who ordered it, and it wasn't that great in my opinion which is why I am knocking down a star. So I will probably stick to other places in Chinatown for bubble tea. Overall I highly recommend everyone try their crepes because it will not disappoint.

I was making my list of things to do, places to visit and things to eat for my trip to Reno/ Tahoe. I've had multiple trips this year that got cancelled because of Rona including a trip to Turkey. I saw Pangolin Cafe has Turkish delight, Turkish coffee, and Turkish tea so clearly, I had to come here. I just couldn't decide if I should go in the morning before my hike when they open at 8 or after my hike.

I decided to come here after my hike as a treat before closing time. I wanted to get a tin of a Turkish delights to take home with me but I started eating them at the airport. Although I prefer hot tea, they were right in recommending iced Turkish tea on a hot day. They gave me raspberry delight, and pistachio delight for free to go with my iced tea. Yum yum yuuuummm!!! For my 1lb tin of Turkish delights, I got vanilla rose, cardamom cashew, pistachio, tart raspberry, matcha, Hawaiian, and pom pistachio. My favorites from my selection: pistachio, Hawaiian, Pom pistachio, and tart raspberry for the flavor; matcha because I like matcha and it's not a traditional Turkish delight flavor. The vanilla rose is a good place to start if you want to try Turkish delight for the first time. Rose is one of the most common flavor for Turkish delights but people (including myself) find it tastes like soap - so by making vanilla rose, you only taste a mild rose flavor which is nice.

The interior is very cute and simple. The customer service is impeccable and personable. It might have been
Pizza here is delicious, they have selection and are generous with the toppings! Great place to walk in and grab a couple slices and a bottled soda!

I literally dream about the Alfredo sauce pizza. We love the atmosphere - it feels very friendly and welcoming - very home-y! All the staff is super kind and friendly as well. Perfect place for a yummy, quick bite during the week, or some great pizza and a beer on the weekend!

Ordered a 14" Triple Pie to go. Was really cheesy and full of different bits of meat, not like loaded, but adequate. And I enjoyed the heat, as it was just the right amount I wanted. The crust was really tasty, almost sweet!  Service was very friendly from everyone I encountered. But mainly my five star review is for their homemade ranch dressing. I asked for some to dip my pizza in and guuhhhhhhh....it was DELICIOUS! Made me very, very happy. If you are a ranch dressing fan, this place will deliver. Next time I will try their salad bar

At the Gaylord for a conference. Since the bbq place on-site had an hour wait, we ventured to the Mexican place that was also onsite. It was closed so we came next to to try Ravello. 

Service was top notch. Our server Romany was very attentive and accommodating. He and the other wait staff made sure you wanted for nothing. 

I ordered an antipasto salad and and fennel sausage tagliatelle pasta. The wide noodles mixed well with the vodka sauce and sausage/veggies. My only complaint is the amount of veggies in my pasta. I would have loved to have more but it is what it is. 

Enjoyed my visit here. I plan to visit again for some pizza because it looked really good.

So I had the Cubano. 
Good :
1. The pork was good. Like good pulled pork. Lots of flavor. 
2. The ham was very good.  
3. Had pickles that looked good. 

Bad:
1. Sandwich bread was very greasy. 
2. Bread and Sandwich were ridiculously grease drenched. Comically - like an exaggeration of making it greasy. 
3. Could not taste cheese,pickles,or bread there was so much saturation of sandwich. 
4. No turkey. 

Do people like this? Maybe that is what they want?

Anyway....Cubano's that I have had are not like this. You need to taste the flattened bland white bread roll. You have to taste the ingredients. 

I ate the meat and they were excellent. Great flavor! They could easily have a five star sandwich with the meats. It is so close.
The gnocchi and diatoms pizza (plus meatballs) were delicious and perfectly cooked. Keep your gnocchi bowl and dip the crust in the juices - annnnd you're welcome.

Customer service sucks!! When they first opened they had the greatest people. Now, not so much. Ordered online and walked in to pick up, stood in line and after the person in front of me, I stepped up...the girl at the register didn't even acknowledge me and walked off. When I said "hello, I'm standing her," she can back and said "I assumed you were with her." I said, "well you just looked right over me." Customer Service 101 dear! I don't work for your. I told them they could keep the money w/ the $2.00 tip. I won't be back; and I work across the street. Do yourself a favor and go to Steins, next door. Much better customer service!!

Grays has been a family favorite for as long as I can remember (and nothing has changed about it in about 20 years either). It's home cooked southern food, so if you're looking for vegan options, you will be hard pressed to find them here. However, if you're looking for the best pie around- you've come to the right place. 

Ordering is cafeteria style (of course the desserts are first). Portions are BIG. An order of fried chicken comes with 3 pieces- that with some sides and pie, most people would be fine to split an entree. 

Seating is first come first serve in large rooms with a variety of different sizes tables. 
At our last visit we did notice it was really dark in the dining rooms and they would benefit from better lighting.

Yum! We were driving from Michigan to Oklahoma and thought we could drive through St Louis and pick up bbq. The pulled pork was tender, flavorful and lean. The coleslaw was vinegar based with a little sweet and a little celery seed. I'd highly recommend!

Third time here! So good. Love the summer rolls! We've ordered them every time. The flame broiled pork is so delicious. Everything is fresh and tasty. Great service. The only thing I would say it would be nice if there was some outside light. Went for lunch and it felt like dinner. The sun light was blinding when we walked out.

This was a rough experience- I LOVE southern food & was totally let down by their overuse of salt, & I mean to the point where things were not edible & we made salt jokes well into our night out. 

Prices aren't outrageous here but overpriced for the lack of flavor in food.  

This place took over the location of an Irish style sports bar that I love- excellent location with tons of potential so I'm hopeful they get in together in the kitchen! 

I'm open to giving this place another try when in Boise!

I'm writing this review while still in the lobby because I'm that happy about finding this restaurant! everyone was so kind, and the food was better than I could have hoped for. I wish that I lived nearby so I could come back again and again!

I don't wanna write a bad review. I have friends that work here and it's the "cool" pizza place in town so everyone I know likes it. 
But it needs to be done, the service tonight screwed over myself and my coworkers. 

Work downtown, sizzle pie is one of the few easy restaurants we can walk to get pick up orders. 

Placed a pick-up order but told the person on the phone I'd call back if we needed to change that to delivery. That must have been confusing because when my coworker went to pick it up there was no order for us at all. 

He ordered it again, but had to clock in before it was ready so he spent his entire break at Sizzle without eating. 

I went to pick it up an hour later on my break. Got back to work to realize they gave us the wrong size, and we had to feed 6 people with the 12" instead of the 18" we paid for. 

TLDR: payed $30 and waited 2 hours for a 12" cheese pizza.
The worst hot pot I've ever had. The sauces were rancid, their broth was full of msg, and the meat was all frozen and in chunks. The freezers were also leaking.

i wish i could give them a negative number! i spend over $30 today the meat in my order was missing only beans and rice!!! i called them several times and no one is answering the phone. i emailed them and it was returned. this is horrible customer service you can not get a person on the phone!!! voicemail is full!  i want a full refund.
Holy Grail of street tacos! This place is a hidden gem with incredible service! Food is fantastic, the Al Pastor and Veggie tacos shine, but all are soooo good.

I am so excited that we ya dinner here! I also invited a Californian with me and he was soooo impressed! We have guests coming in a few months and I will bring them here! The service was good and the food exceptional!

The new staff here is rude, non helpful at all, this used to be my favorite place to eat and are here everyday. The select  crew members that was here before and are still here are all awesome. I asked one of the crew members if I could get some jets up because they were out at the drink station, and she just rolled her eyes at me. I told her forget it, and I wouldn't be back!!!! This is terrible as I always loved coming here. I guess I'll have to find a new place to eat. Bonnie, Lucy, and Cecilia are super nice, absolutely the most professional people I've met in fast food. They have always been very nice, very helpful and always have a smile of their faces and are the only reason I come here, but after today I'm not sure. 
Ron Davis
317-418-4630

I had thought all restaurants had gone the way of franchises, eash one a clone of the other with mediocre food. I was delighted to finally go to Iavarones, an iconic Tampa family owned restaurant. It was lunchtime so we chose to sit in the lounge, where it was clear all the regulars were. The ambiance was just what I was hoping for and the food was excellent.  We will now be one of the regulars.

If I could give this place ZERO stars I would. Went to celebrate a friends birthday on a not so busy night and the experience was horrible!!! "Kelsi" the waitress was a fucking shit show, she had an attitude from the time we sat at the table and started ordering drinks. Kobe was another waiter and he came to the rescue. He was awesome and made our experience a whole lot better. If it wasn't for him I would have just left. The manager was not trying to really hear our complaints but it's okay, Kobe came through with the 3......SWOOSH! Food was cold btw, and the steaks were dry.

Upon entering this place it has a very cool vibe with music that makes me want to live here;). The team here were so sweet and polite to each and every guest. They were honest with their opinions and made recommendations for me as I was a little unsure what to get. They steeped my tea perfectly. Everything was absolutely great. I would definitely revisit this place can't believe it took me this long to visit. 

Side note I was pleasantly surprised and happy to see they also have beer for the evening so u may get back sooner rather than later. 

You won't be disappointed. Visit this place as soon as you can.

Excellent falafels in really great pita sandwiches. We tried all three sauces, and I really enjoyed all three, with the harissa probably being my favorite. My wife got her sandwich without the Israeli salad because she was worried about the parsely (she hates herbs), but it was very mild and next time she'd probably include it. The fries with the shawarma sauce were excellent as well and definitely worth ordering next visit.
Food is very good, service is OK. The only reason it didn't get 5 stars is due to the very expensive prices.

I enjoyed the brunch buffet. I would have given five stars, for the food offerings alone, but the service was a bit odd. The omelette guy disappeared after I ordered my omelette and went for some lox. He had it ready and covered when I looked a few minutes later. The waiter dis not visit frequently to get another drink etc. And the dining room in the bar area where we sat was filled with dirty tables uncleared. I would have enjoyed the experience more of the dining room looked neat instead of cluttered w dirty dishes w half eaten food. I guess the waiter was waiting for the busboy to clear out the dining room. Not sure, but lazy service is a turn off. It is a buffet. How hard is it when the customer does not order from the waiter and the customer goes and gets their own food?  This happened on a Sunday. Eagles were playing. Tv was visible in the bar area. 

The food was great. Lox tray, scrambled eggs, sausages, bacon, muffins and doughnuts. Roast beef au jus ham, cheese tray, fruit tray, maybe a roasted turkey or two, waffles, pancakes, nice breads,  they also have a nice a la cart menu.

A great acai place to eat at! Only downfall is that no one is really enforcing social distancing here and it does not look like they care that much about the safety of customers. I got the island bowl which was really good except they put excessive amounts of granola in this bowl. My friend ordered the berry bowl and hers did not come with as much granola as mines. I really like that they put a lot of fruits and overall worth the price. Would definitely come back when returning to SB.

The Delaware Welcome center is very nice. It REALLY stands out from any of the other rest stops. There are two sets of bathrooms, many many food options like a Starbucks, Cinnabon and a few others. The Starbucks and a few other places were not open due to COVID, but still stop in since the rest will be open. There is also a mini store, kind of like a 7-11, where you can buy snacks, sweatshirts and drinks.

The crab was great, sauces was on point.. The hot sauce was not hot hot. But a nice hot taste.

Would definitely go back again...
Overpriced for the food but the ambiance is amazing. My coworker and I had a lovely time and the wait staff was very accommodating!

Hip breakfast spot with a young crowd . They offered a large creative menu . It's not a diner breakfast for sure. The " million dollar" bacon was good and definitely worth a try. I had pumpkin pancakes which are hard to find in September. I usually have to wait till October. 
Water comes to your table in a bottle so you refill your own glass. I drink lots of water so this was a plus for me. 
My partner had the breakfast tacos with chorizo .. and was happy ....the wait for food was long but they were crowded, the waitress was friendly.... I'll go back

This place is amazing. We've have had almost everything on the menu. Everything on there is worth eating. Mateo is the man when it comes to reinventing traditional and making it exceptional. I definitely recommend eating here.

I said "I'm going to order take-out calzones for dinner."  This was met with "What's a calzone?"  and "I've never heard of a calzone."  No problem, when I came back with a stack of Sauce on the Side takeout boxes (Meat me in St. Louis for meat-eaters and Garden for vegetarians), people were very pleased.  The calzones were a hit.

Make sure u check for accuracy of ur orders before leaving- I was missing my drink. 

The food is ok- fast and good variety.
The soup for breadbowl was skimpy but I'll be back
At the top of the game in the terms of the quality of product, attentive of service, and providing  huge value at the right price point. Keep up the hard work. It shows.

Fresh ingredients is what makes this place sit above the rest.  From there the owner really cares about his clients.  Too bad it's in a strip mall.

Place changed owners in the last year. The Prices since have gone up 15-20%.  More importantly, the vegetables and the sushi  are not as fresh.

After several days of dining in New Orleans at somewhat disappointing restaurants, which is historically unusual, my last morning before a long drive back to Nashville we stumbled upon Marjoria's Commerce Restaurant for breakfast. And man was I satisfied. Its an old fashioned diner, with very engaging employees. The waitress was so much fun and accommodating. Let me preface by saying that I am a breakfast snob, extremely picky about my eggs. I ordered 2 eggs over medium, sausage patties, hash browns and toast. The last restaurant that I had breakfast at, a couple days before was awful. However, Marjoria's Commerce did not disappoint. My eggs were cooked perfectly, the hash browns were delicious and the sausage patties were huge. My eggs were so good that I ordered another. Thanks for not allowing my last day in New Orleans to leave a "bad taste in my mouth". Very good breakfast, can't wait to return and try some other menu items.

I ordered the level 4 Pad Thai and it was delicious authentic Thai food! I'm from Vegas and coming up to Reno it was hard to find a new place to get good Pad Thai and this place is the best in Reno. The other restaurants  Pad Thai was usually dry, lacked spice and flavor, and that's the exact opposite of what Moo Dang delivered, exceptional service and remarkable food!

The host was awesome. The waiter on the other hand, actually looked like he was scowling at us. He stopped -very briefly-three times- to tell us "I'll be right with you." After the third time, and after waiting more than 20 minutes to even speak to him, we left. It's too bad, because we are Great tippers. His mistake.

Wings and wedges are delicious. If you like sweet and spicy, ask for mango habanero.  I always get sauce on the side and request for all flats; keeps the wings crispy and juicy. I'm not a big fan of the Mac N Cheese or tacos.

just get your bagel to go and leave. costs $.25 extra to toast them. my smoothie with just orange juice, mango, pineapple, raspberry's, and strawberries cost $8.5 and the oj is gross and has barely any flavor. way overpriced for the bad quality and service. they took our food before we were done.

Pop N Sons Diner is a Tampa Icon Diner. I used to fall asleep as a young girl after Dad raced at East Bay Raceway in Gibsonton. Late night, early morning or a perfect lunch hour, you ALWAYS have a great waitress and a great meal. Now that I'm 40, and I race sprint cars...They have supported me, the local female dirt racer. Due to their support I am able to make memories that most daughters Never get to make with not only their Dad, but their wonderful husband. Go, take a trip to the diner, look at the walls to check out our race cars, and tell them ACL sent you!!

My Wife, Friends, and I stopped here for some pre haunted house drinks and some post haunted house food. Yes, we were here twice in the same night. 

It's pretty much your typical Sports Bar & Grill. There's plenty of seating to choose from (seat yourself), just about any kind of beer or drink you could think of, and your garden variety fried fare along with burgers and sandwiches. Nothing special to be found. 

We ordered some boneless wings and mozzarella sticks and they were good. Again, nothing special as it's pretty difficult to screw those two things up. 

Would I go back? The staff were great, the place was clean, and the food was decent, so ya. I wouldn't go out of my way to go back but if I found myself here again by pure chance I wouldn't mind too much.

Okay, I'll start by saying the same thing I said to one of the employees on my way out the door.

I am picky as f*ck. 

That being said, my girlfriend was reluctant to bring me here, because if it's not steak and potatoes it's usually not for me. Granted, I'm a huge spice/pepper guy, so this place is like HEAVEN for me.

We had a couple different tacos, Seared Chorizo, Mojo Pork Carnitas, Sesame Ribeye, Glazed Pork Belly, Roasted Duck, and Spiced Chicken Verde. They absolutely SLAMMED. I personally wasn't a huge fan of the ribeye, but I'm not exactly a huge soy guy so that's on me 100%.

Also, we started with the chips and salsa/guac, dear lord, those warm tortillas are phenomenal. I usually think guacamole is under-flavored, theirs is spiced perfectly. The salsas (rojo and verde) are both banginnnnnnnnnnnnnn. (Pro Tip, add a little of the "spicy" sauce (yellowish) to your guac.)

I had the Tres Leche cake at the end, I wish I took a picture of it in the cute little glass, but it was gone as soon as I got the first taste of it. My girl got the vanilla gelato, also killer. These are MUST haves, especially after abusing your tongue with the kick of all the different sauces/spices. You deserve some Tres Leche heaven. 

I don't think I'll ever be able to eat Old El Paso ever again, I'm sorry mom.

Went for it, and we loved it!! 
We couldn't decide what to eat on a dragging day like today so we hopped on Yelp. I have a very picky boyfriend when it comes to food so it takes us awhile to choose a place lol now I also am not a huge Mexican fan lover, but this place might've just changed that. 
I'm so glad we chose this one! It was super quiet upon arriving as there was only 2 other couples in there and one was leaving. 
Got sat and had chips and salsa with waters right away! 
The salsa was really yummy! Had a unique sweet flavor that I haven't had before. 
The street tacos that we got for our appetizer were definitely the star of the show though. SO GOOD. I had these at the recommendation of my boyfriend and i am so happy I did! The flavor was spot on. I'm not a huge street taco fan but I would eat these all day every day!! 
My chimi was huge. I couldn't even finish it. Boyfriend said the Chile was on of the best he's ever had. 
Come to find out that one of the owners was our waitress and she was the absolute sweetest! Loved the perfect mom and pop thing they have going on here and we will definitely be back!

The heat must be melting down the temperatures on their ice cream machine because we all received delicious drinks but with light stomach aches after wards that last until the next day. Please have your machines checked out or the vendors you're buying from. I like having the shop in the area but not at the extent of a stomach ace.

Great brick oven pizza! We went on a weekend do the place was packed. But over all, I would definitely return! 

Plus, fantastical bathrooms!

From reservations to meal it was an inhospitable experience. The reservations office isn't open during the hours they say, and when you do get in touch they call back the wrong number and then are rude about their mistake...? 

Food was underwhelming and the service was severely lacking. The server actually put my grandpas napkin in his lap while he was vaguely introducing himself and IT WAS BEYOND offensive, also my grandpa was not eating due to a medical issue and the server was super not cool about it. (Even though he ordered something to go so as not to affect his tip)

We came for an early Mother's Day dinner and all decided we'd be fine never coming back. Really disappointing experience in every way.

Came in at 12:45ish and ordered food at the back by the time we found a table in the front and ordered a few drinks the food was coming to the table hot and ready! The piggyback fries are AMAZING! The devil! This is sober talk! Made me wanna get drunk and eat them again! Also just a note the crowd definitely grew around 1am Sunday! Definitely adding it to "my list".

This was our 1st visit to Noble Hops. It was a great experience!  Friendly, fun and knowledgeable wait staff. I love wait staff that interact with the customers. It always makes the experience more enjoyable. The food was excellent. We enjoyed a variety of food ( kale salad, duck, short ribs and ahi salad). And appetizers Brussels sprouts and bacon  wrapped dates. Yum yum!  The beer was cold and a good variety.  For a fun relaxing meal I would highly recommend!!!!!

Came in and were told the wait would be 30 mins which is fine, then the cook told us we needed to get out if we already put our name in because there wasn't room for us to wait inside. So we ( four year old in tow) outside into the chilly rain and walked to a coffee shop. Came back 30 minutes later and they said that if we could squeeze our toddler in between us it would be another 15 minutes. So we squeezed into a table that had been open the whole time and ordered. Waitresses were very wonderful. Food:
Challah French toast: okay dry on the inside not much flavor
Egg and cheese croissant: good, I mean it was good but the croissant wasn't very fresh or special. 
Tater tots: good not worth the hype
Mannyoink omelette: good
Brekkie bowl: good

Beyond disappointed. Ordered takeout, prepaid, and not all items were in my order.  Headed back to the restaurant but called first, girl on the phone stated she would have the missing items ready but they weren't.  $5 for a frozen tiramisu and bone and globs of fat in the meatballs.  Not an apology or even a credit for missing items.  Horrible!

Really cute cafe in peddlers village. Very nice decor, French style with a bohemian twist. It has very nice Christmas decorations too! Indoor seating is available! Nice and warm inside. The service was great, seems family owned. I ordered the peddlers salad and a latte. Great food. Also had some fried pickles , yummy! I would definitely recommend this cafe!

So disappointed in this place. Meal was great and server Adam was wonderful, but when it came time to pay, everything went to hell.  Been here multiple times and after getting multiple bottles this time they told us we had to separate our own checks and figure out pricing to split multiple bottles. They told us they couldn't split between each person, and that they couldn't split per person, even though we were all separate and we notated that from the start.  We did the math ourselves and figured out what we had to pay after asking multiple servers for below. When talking to one of the managers, he asked us why they made us split our checks and we literally couldn't understand why he asked us that. Again we told him his service staff told us we couldn't split and offered to help us after we all paid. Our friend proud cash and the manager offered us good cash payment as a fix lol. At that point we just said we had to go and left so unhappy. Adam was great but because of everything else we will frequent Bern's instead..

Do NOT! I repeat do NOT spend your money here. Customer service is terrible! Will take your money, say 20-25 minute wait, really 1-2 hour wait and will not offer you anything for the extended wait time. Took my money and still did not receive food or compensation for time waited. Management blamed it on not being equipped for large crowds (which should be explained before people place their orders!!!!). Again save your money and go patron at another business!

Stopped in for dinner because it was close to my hotel. Should have checked the reviews here first. The decor is nothing special. A bit run down but okay. My waitress looked like she would rather have been someplace else. I ordered a Voodoo Brew cocktail. BBQ shrimp appetizer and the PawPaw fish dish. The cocktail was flavorfull but it came out in a large plastic cup. Red Flag!!!  The BBQ shrimp came shortly after. I began knoshing on the shrimp and after just a few minutes, the waitress appeared with my entree!! I wasn't even half way through my appetizer! Now I know the French Quarter is a tourist area and the name of the game is high turn around. Get them in, feed them, get them out! But talk about the bum's rush. This completely turned me off to this place. I told the waitress that it would be cold before I got to it. I sent it back and asked for the check. Didn't finish the shrimp or cocktail. Definitely NOT recommended!

Food establishment set on the inside of the Hyatt regency in downtown Indy. It was during covid so they was doing to go boxes for breakfast that was ten bucks. It included a couple slices of bacon, a scoop of scrambled eggs, a serving of fried potatoes and a choice of Oj or apple juice.  Costs $10 for that. 

The service here was very top notch. The manager (I assume because he was a guy in suit) was very accommodating and friendly. 

The food was just solid. Nothing great but not terrible. I'm sure in non covid times there menu is more diverse and thrives more. But it hit the spot with what we needed. We was kinda eating on the go anyways  as our daughter was competing on a  cheer comp in the area and had to practice with her team on the second level of the Hyatt.

Amazing! The service was super fast, the food was outstanding and the servers were super nice! We were able to bike there so it had a convenient location (though this doesn't apply to everyone). It was super cute on the inside and had a nice rustic look. There was plenty of comfortable seating inside and outside. They also had a lot of desserts so that Is always good.

The staff here is extremely friendly and helpful. The food is well cooked and enjoyable. However the sides are extremely small. I also believe it's a little expensive at $7 for a pretty small sandwich. Definitely need to work on the size of the sandwich and besides for the prices they're charging

I've had most of their rolls from the numerous times I've ordered from here but my favorite rolls by far are the Chicken tempura and the Dynamite roll. The food is always fresh and delicious. They do have your usual "Chinese takeout" dishes as well. And the delivery time is always accurate. My go-to sushi takeout spot in South Philly!

Not a huge fan of Greek food but Zorba's had very good lamb. Had gyros and enjoyed them. Small, rectangular interior decorated, of course,  in a Mediterranean theme. Tried the honey-cake for dessert but way too sweet.

Hostess was rude and pretentious.   How hard is it to greet someone with a smile (even with Masks) and be polite.  That is the first point of contact and makes an impression.   NOT good. Food was good, but it seems the staff is buying the stuck up BS.   Random Covid Authority happening all over too.  Sitting OUTSIDE, rooftop and still have to wear a mask.   Not buying it or coming back.   Buh Bye

Had been planning a trip to Philly and saw this place on Yelp and wanted to check this place out since the menu looked awesome but they were closed for the whole length of our stay. During our trip we were looking to kill some time in the late afternoon and checked out their website again and saw all sorts of stuff about their Monday to Friday happy hour which was about to start. So we walked the 5 blocks to the restaurant and sure enough completely locked up. Wish they'd used some time in the last 6 months to do an update on their site. Hopefully someday I can revise this review.
Best fried chicken I've ever had. We easily got a seat on a Sunday morning at 9:30am and felt welcome like family.  We will absolutely return!!

Really small portions

Soggy fries

2 onion rings on a $17. Platter?

Terrible Cole slaw

Gluey chowder

Hands down the absolute worst seafood I've ever had anywhere

Didn't expect something great but this was awful

I haven't eaten a lot of Mexican food but this is one of the best I have eaten! 
I like how everything is prepared fresh and tasty. I thought the portion was a little small but turn out it was able just nice for of us. 

We ordered #16(omg yums!!!), gucomole(#18), and one of their specials with banana leaves and chicken breast, beer and large hochata for around $20+. 

I will come here to eat AGAIN!!!

Been here a couple of times and have been consistently disappointed. The soup based dishes are OK, but they skimp hardcore on the meat. Their banh mi sandwiches are 99% bread. It definitely feels like they cut corners.

My friends and I went to the Atlantis spa over the weekend. We would have had a 5 star time if it weren't for the lack of customer service provided by the staff. We got there over an hour early for all of our treatments and the staff acted as if we were a complete burden for them to get all of us set up. They asked us to share lockers. Which would have been fine, but when we asked for one more locker, they acted again as if we were a burden. We weren't offered a tour so we had no idea what was in the spa or where we could relax besides the locker room. After our first treatment, we asked for a tour, and the man giving the tour was completely unenthusiastic and again acted like we were a burden. 
After my first treatment at 11am, the masseuse  mentioned how much I am going to like my next treatment which was at 3. After my last treatment she saw us walking down the hall and said, "Oh, you are STILL here?" Of course I'm still here, you knew that. After paying over a grand to have a relaxing day, I didn't expect everyone to have such a horrible attitude. 
All of my friends said they enjoyed their treatments and we all did have a relaxing day using the other services the spa offered. I just wish the staff was more genuine. 
I liked the Atlantis Spa more than the Peppermill in a few ways, like their therapy lounge is gorgeous and the herbal steam room is better than the Peppermill. But you have to share the pool with the hotel guests which isn't the worst thing, but the Atlantis p

Food is very good. For pickup be sure to call ahead as most items are made fresh it takes a few minutes to prepare, but this is what I love. My family and I love their food best and most authentic Mexican food in this area. Restaurant is clean and staff is friendly

Brunch was amazing and the prices were spot on..... except for the $4.00  cup of coffee that was not bottomless. 
Really ridiculous,  since they don't put it on the menu, and surprise you in the bill.
I get it... you're a brewery,  but coffee at brunch... come on.

We were planning to go to Sonic's when we spotted this Vietnamese restaurant and decided to give them a try. We came in at 7:40pm and they let us dine in even though they closed at 8pm, that was a great gesture since it was our bad. They seated us and the owner was talking to us and explaining why they had to social distance us and we were completely okay with that as they were just following protocol and can't ask for more. We looked at their menu on their website since they were a little busy and we wanted to make it painless for them since we were going to eat fast. We got the P1 House Special Pho and P3 Meatball Pho in regular sizes. The waitress was very nice and was very attentive. The pho was a little more expensive that we are used to as their regular pho was $10 and large was $12 but we gave it a shot. We received our food within 10 minutes and the meatball portion was HUGE! The noodles and broth were good and I didn't think it would make me full but it did! I was very pleased with this place. The bathrooms were clean and the kitchen was open so you could see them preparing your food which was a plus. I definitely plan to return to this place!

This is probably the worst Taco Bell around! Iv eaten here many times but this past time my girlfriend and I went was the worst! First off it was so cold inside, the staff thought it was funny how cold it was, we over heard one of the works say "we are trying to freeze out the customers". Second the manager would not let us get a side of the Nashville hot sauce when we have got it on the side at this location before. The woman at the register told us we couldn't have it because her manager said no then said she would just grab it for us, as she went to get it he wouldn't let her so I had to order twice to get the sauce we wanted. Then we tried to order a burrito with out the tortilla and the manager came out said "what do you want" we just said no tortilla and he proceeded to roll his eyes and just walk in the back. The woman at the front (Destiny, I believe) was the only nice thing about this place as she was trying to be helpful. Hire new management that actually cares about properly serving their customers. Until then, we will never be back! Side note - food was good.

Could talk about this place forever! I have formed a close friendship with the owner due to outstanding customer service! Their pastries and macaron's top it off! Hands down my favorite place in Tucson!

Tres Yan & Wu is hands down, the absolute BEST Pan-Asian cuisine in South Jersey! It's ALWAYS hot, fresh and delicious! Even during this time of COVID, I still receive the same fantastic service! I've been several times since they reopened for takeout only. Over the years, I've turned several friends on to them and they're hooked too!
I used to order from here all the time back when I lived in Roxborough. I would always get the taco pizza, it's beyond good. Delivery was always quick.
Best corn tamales period! Beautiful green chili flavor, moist, and delicious. The cashier told me the recipe is unique to this restaurant. If you like tamales, give them a try. Amazing!

I recently ordered food from this establishment .  The food was good and appropriately seasoned but the fish filet portion size for the fish dinners were nothing to write home about.  They give you half of one filet, cut down the middle to make two pieces.  Their fish meals definitely doesn't match their advertised photos.  Also, they had patrons going in and out of the restaurant without required mask.  I enjoyed the food but will pass on any future purchases until they can get the mask situation resolved.
